rules.grid: 3x3 contact sheet, nine different card illustrations, one per cell, left to right then top to bottom
rules.cell: landscape 4:3 cell; keep the subject inside the central 80% so it survives cropping to the card art window
rules.forbidden: card frames, portrait card mockups, borders, typography, rules text, labels, numbers, watermarks, logos, UI
rules.reprints: reuse the original illustration; never requested again
